integrity.mathematical_basis: Exact fourth-order Fourier eigenvalue perturbation and weighted-circle-measure extremal inequality.
integrity.numerical_checks: Symbolic identities and high-precision finite Fourier diagnostics; numerical tests are not used as an infinite proof.

scientific_limitations: Long-time longitudinal fourth-cumulant rate, not finite-time fourth-cumulant sign.
Independent symmetric Poisson angular tumbles and rotational diffusion D>0; intrinsic chirality Omega>D.
No fixed-rate optimization or interactions; upper sharp endpoint is only a supremum as optimal tumble rate diverges.
Publication-priority novelty is not independently confirmed.
title: Sharp fourth-cumulant range at optimal diffusion for chiral tumblers
